rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive read-write access to SAP ABAP Development Tools (ADT) across on-premise ECC/S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP Cloud systems. Supports full CRUD operations for classes, interfaces, function groups, programs, CDS views, RAP artifacts, DDIC objects, and more. Includes deep analysis capabilities such as where-used lookups, semantic analysis, dependency exploration, and impact assessment. Offers destination-based authentication with JWT/XSUAA and service-key support, with stdio, HTTP, and SSE transport options.
